selection_fallback: None; absence is a recorded failure
scope: Only existing full-throttle, unbraked, same-gear/DRS adjacent windows. Every discontinuity starts a separately observed-speed-initialised segment. No extrapolation into omitted intervals.
model: Cumulative work-energy in time, with drag cubed speed evaluated at observed midpoint: v_end^2=v_segment_start^2+sum(2 dt (base+deployment-drag*v_mid^3)/mass). Conditional quadrature, not free-running prediction.
action_blocks: Constant mechanical deployment within each segment-local 2 second block, split only at native row boundaries

physical_grid.scaling: base and drag multiplied by mass/800; illustrative confounding family near earlier development-only effective total-power diagnostic, not confidence bounds

energy_scope: Conservative concatenation of selected propulsion windows: zero deployment and zero recovery outside them. No recovery is eligible inside unbraked windows. Feasibility is only for this partial-window accounting; omitted braking/propulsion is unknown and full-lap compatibility is not established.

optimizer.objective: mean squared endpoint speed discrepancy; common linear cumulative energy inequality

compatibility.interpretation: Declared illustrative engineering mismatch tolerances, not sensor confidence intervals. Require optimizer success, both motion limits, and physical/partial energy constraints; no threshold revision or alternative lap selection after fitting.

claims: Conditional feasibility and nonuniqueness only. No actual deployment/battery estimates, official timing-line/geometry alignment, empirical full-lap validation, uncertainty coverage, or independent final-test result. Repeated starts are numerical checks, not independent data.
